newsitem.title: USA: World Airways Inc Q3 oper shr falls.
newsitem.headline: World Airways Inc Q3 oper shr falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Revenue figures were not immediately available.
1996 third quarter net was $3.1 million or $0.26 per share, compared to 1995 net of $3.4 million, or $0.33 per share.

1996 nine-month net was a loss of $18.8 million, or $1.57 per share, compared to net of $10.5 million or $1.04 per share for 1995 nine-months. Net loss for 1996 nine-months reflects losses on discontinued operations through the second quarter and second quarter accrual for estimated losses and costs in connection with the phase out of discontinued operations.

The company later reported 1996 third quarter revenue of $75.8 million, compared to 1995 third quarter revenues of $69.4 million. Revenue for the nine-month period 1996 were $227.8 million, compared to $185.7 million for 1995.
